headline: 'Golden' logs 74th week on UK Official Singles Chart
sub: KPop Demon Hunters hit sits at No. 67 in the UK Top 100
caption:
'Golden' from KPop Demon Hunters is still holding on in the UK, now in its 74th week on the Official Singles Chart Top 100.

The HUNTR/X track placed No. 67 on this week's UK Official Singles Chart, keeping its run in the Top 100 going for 74 weeks. The song spent multiple weeks at No. 1 in the UK last year.

📌 Source: Yonhap News (via Korean media)
